title: Smart Inventory Management System
subtitle: Professional Enterprise UI Design System & Component Library
mode_desc: Optimized for high-density scanability, predictable keyboard affordances, and zero-distraction warehouse operations.
section_buttons_desc: Solid, semantic buttons with rigorous states: default, hover, focus-visible ring, active press, disabled, and loading spinner.
section_inputs_desc: Accessible inputs with labels, helper hints, validation errors, prefixes, suffixes, and character counters.
section_selects_desc: Native <select> controls styled with high fidelity, preserving fast keyboard navigation and OS native accessibility.
section_checkboxes_desc: Accessible checkbox controls supporting unchecked, checked, and indeterminate tri-state states.
section_badges_desc: High-contrast status badges pairing subtle backgrounds with clear semantic text and optional indicator dots.
section_cards_desc: Structured panels with clean 1px borders, subtle enterprise shadows, and optional hover micro-elevation.
section_table_desc: Full-featured enterprise table supporting column sorting, multi-row selection, skeleton pulse loading, and teaching empty states.
section_modal_desc: Native HTML5 <dialog> modals with focus management, backdrop clicks, Escape key listeners, and portal rendering.
section_dropdown_desc: Accessible action menus with keyboard navigation (Arrows, Enter, Escape) and danger dividers.
section_loading_desc: Content placeholders using pulse skeletons to prevent layout shift, with inline spinners for actions.
section_empty_desc: Empty states that educate the operator on what belongs here and how to take the next productive action.
section_alerts_desc: Non-disruptive feedback banners with status-tinted surfaces, icon accents, and dismiss controls.
